title: bugbot verifier verdict
description: verdicts/<finder>.<index>.<verifier>.json: one verifier's verdict on one candidate (candidates/<finder>.json, candidates[index]); verifier is v1, v2 or v3. Written by the verifier agent into verdicts/ (created by fetch); read by `bugbot findings`, which counts the verdicts and writes findings.json. One file per verdict, so verifiers run in parallel without sharing a file. Holds only the judgment: which candidate and which verifier come from the file name, and a verdict older than its candidates file is refused (the finder ran again after it). Fetch empties the folder when the PR's head changes.

verdict.description: keep: real, introduced or made reachable by this PR, worth a person's time. cut: any of the three fails. unsure: could not settle it by reading.

reason.description: One sentence a person can check: what was read and what it showed. For cut, the concrete cause.

checks.description: The three questions, answered separately, so the retro sees which one cuts most.

real.description: The evidence matches the code at the cited lines, every cited rule exists verbatim in its source, and the explanation describes a defect that follows from them.

from_pr.description: yes: the PR introduced it. pre_existing: it is on the base too, and the PR's change touches or relies on it. no: unrelated to what the PR changed.

matters.description: yes: a defect a person should act on. no: style, cleanup, preference, or what CI already enforces.

cut_reason.description: For cut, the category: evidence_mismatch, rule_not_found, not_a_defect, unrelated_to_pr, style_only, unverified_intent, tool_noise, duplicate.

severity.description: The severity the verifier finds right. The assembly uses the highest severity supported by a keep verdict.

duplicate_of.description: For cut as duplicate: the other candidate it repeats, as <finder>/<index>.

agent.description: Who wrote this file, filled by the CLI from the harness's log (the dispatch named bugbot:<repo name>#<number>:<output>), never by the agent. Absent when the log was not found.

model.description: Model that actually ran (may differ from the agent's frontmatter).

effort.description: Reasoning effort the harness logged; null when it logs none (usually its default).

session.description: Harness session id of the orchestrator that dispatched it.

run.description: The sub-agent's own id in that session's log (Copilot and Claude Code: agentId): tells apart runs that share the session.
